verses.original: Πρὸ δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ πάσχα εἰδὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα ἵνα μεταβῇ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ἀγαπήσας τοὺς ἰδίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰς τέλος ἠγάπησεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Pro de tēs heortēs tou pascha eidōs ho Iēsous hoti ēlthen autou hē hōra hina metabē ek tou kosmou toutou pros ton Patera agapēsas tous idious tous en tō kosmō eis telos ēgapēsen autous
verses.literal: It was now just before the Passover Feast and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave . . . this world and return to the Father Having loved His own who were in the world He loved them to the very end

verses.original: καὶ δείπνου γινομένου τοῦ διαβόλου ἤδη βεβληκότος εἰς τὴν καρδίαν ἵνα παραδοῖ αὐτὸν Ἰούδας Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου
verses.transliteration: kai deipnou ginomenou tou diabolou ēdē beblēkotos eis tēn kardian hina paradoi auton Ioudas Simōnos Iskariōtou
verses.literal: The evening meal was underway and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot to betray Jesus

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι πάντα ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ Πατὴρ εἰς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὑπάγει
verses.transliteration: eidōs hoti panta edōken autō ho Patēr eis tas cheiras kai hoti apo Theou exēlthen kai pros ton Theon hypagei
verses.literal: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands and that He had come from God and was returning to God

verses.original: ἐγείρεται ἐκ τοῦ δείπνου καὶ τίθησιν τὰ ἱμάτια καὶ λαβὼν λέντιον διέζωσεν ἑαυτόν
verses.transliteration: egeiretai ek tou deipnou kai tithēsin ta himatia kai labōn lention diezōsen heauton
verses.literal: So He got up from the supper laid aside His outer garments and wrapped a towel around His waist

verses.original: εἶτα βάλλει ὕδωρ εἰς τὸν νιπτῆρα καὶ ἤρξατο νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας τῶν μαθητῶν καὶ ἐκμάσσειν τῷ λεντίῳ ᾧ ἦν διεζωσμένος
verses.transliteration: eita ballei hydōr eis ton niptēra kai ērxato niptein tous podas tōn mathētōn kai ekmassein tō lentiō hō ēn diezōsmenos
verses.literal: After that He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him

verses.original: Ἔρχεται οὖν πρὸς Σίμωνα Πέτρον λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε σύ μου νίπτεις τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: Erchetai oun pros Simōna Petron legei autō Kyrie sy mou nipteis tous podas
verses.literal: He came to Simon Peter who asked Him Lord are You going to wash my feet

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ σὺ οὐκ οἶδας ἄρτι γνώσῃ δὲ μετὰ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Ho egō poiō sy ouk oidas arti gnōsē de meta tauta
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . You do not realize now what I am doing but later you will understand

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Πέτρος Οὐ μὴ νίψῃς μου τοὺς πόδας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ Ἐὰν μὴ νίψω σε οὐκ ἔχεις μέρος μετ’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Petros Ou mē nipsēs mou tous podas eis ton aiōna Apekrithē Iēsous autō Ean mē nipsō se ouk echeis meros met’ emou
verses.literal: Never . . . shall You wash my feet - Peter told Him Jesus answered Unless . . . I wash you you have no part with Me

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος Κύριε μὴ τοὺς πόδας μου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τὴν κεφαλήν
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Simōn Petros Kyrie mē tous podas mou monon alla kai tas cheiras kai tēn kephalēn
verses.literal: Then, Lord Simon Peter replied not only my feet but my hands and my head as well

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὁ λελουμένος οὐκ ἔχει χρείαν εἰ μὴ τοὺς πόδας νίψασθαι ἀλλ’ ἔστιν καθαρὸς ὅλος καὶ ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε ἀλλ’ οὐχὶ πάντες
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Ho leloumenos ouk echei chreian ei mē tous podas nipsasthai all’ estin katharos holos kai hymeis katharoi este all’ ouchi pantes
verses.literal: Jesus told him Whoever has already bathed - needs only . . . to wash his feet and he will be completely clean And you are clean though not all of you

verses.original: ᾔδει γὰρ τὸν παραδιδόντα αὐτόν διὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν ὅτι Οὐχὶ πάντες καθαροί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: ēdei gar ton paradidonta auton dia touto eipen hoti Ouchi pantes katharoi este
verses.literal: For He knew who would betray Him That is why . . . He said Not all of you are clean

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἔνιψεν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέπεσεν πάλιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γινώσκετε τί πεποίηκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hote oun enipsen tous podas autōn kai elaben ta himatia autou kai anepesen palin eipen autois Ginōskete ti pepoiēka hymin
verses.literal: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments He reclined with them again and asked . . . Do you know what I have done for you

verses.original: ὑμεῖς φωνεῖτέ με Ὁ Διδάσκαλος καὶ ὁ Κύριος καὶ καλῶς λέγετε εἰμὶ γάρ
verses.transliteration: hymeis phōneite me HO Didaskalos kai ho Kyrios kai kalōs legete eimi gar
verses.literal: You call Me Teacher and Lord and rightly so because I am

verses.original: εἰ οὖν ἐγὼ ἔνιψα ὑμῶν τοὺς πόδας ὁ Κύριος καὶ ὁ Διδάσκαλος καὶ ὑμεῖς ὀφείλετε ἀλλήλων νίπτειν τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: ei oun egō enipsa hymōn tous podas ho Kyrios kai ho Didaskalos kai hymeis opheilete allēlōn niptein tous podas
verses.literal: So if I your Lord and Teacher have washed your feet you also should wash one another’s feet

verses.original: ὑπόδειγμα γὰρ ἔδωκα ὑμῖν ἵνα καθὼς ἐγὼ ἐποίησα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ποιῆτε
verses.transliteration: hypodeigma gar edōka hymin hina kathōs egō epoiēsa hymin kai hymeis poiēte
verses.literal: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ ἀπόστολος μείζων τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin ouk estin doulos meizōn tou kyriou autou oude apostolos meizōn tou pempsantos auton
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you no servant is greater than his master nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him

verses.original: εἰ ταῦτα οἴδατε μακάριοί ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε αὐτά
verses.transliteration: ei tauta oidate makarioi este ean poiēte auta
verses.literal: If you know these things you will be blessed if you do them

verses.original: Οὐ περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν λέγω ἐγὼ οἶδα τίνας ἐξελεξάμην ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ Ὁ τρώγων μου τὸν ἄρτον ἐπῆρεν ἐπ’ ἐμὲ τὴν πτέρναν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ou peri pantōn hymōn legō egō oida tinas exelexamēn all’ hina hē graphē plērōthē Ho trōgōn mou ton arton epēren ep’ eme tēn pternan autou
verses.literal: I am not speaking about all of you I know whom I have chosen But this is to fulfill the Scripture The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me

verses.original: ἀπ’ ἄρτι λέγω ὑμῖν πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι ἵνα πιστεύσητε ὅταν γένηται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι
verses.transliteration: ap’ arti legō hymin pro tou genesthai hina pisteusēte hotan genētai hoti egō eimi
verses.literal: I am telling you now before it happens so that when it comes to pass you will believe that I am He

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ λαμβάνων ἄν τινα πέμψω ἐμὲ λαμβάνει ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ λαμβάνων λαμβάνει τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin ho lambanōn an tina pempsō eme lambanei ho de eme lambanōn lambanei ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever receives the one I send receives Me and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me

verses.original: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐταράχθη τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἐμαρτύρησεν καὶ εἶπεν Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με
verses.transliteration: Tauta eipōn ho Iēsous etarachthē tō pneumati kai emartyrēsen kai eipen Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti heis ex hymōn paradōsei me
verses.literal: After Jesus had said this He became troubled in spirit and testified . . . . . . Truly truly I tell you one of you will betray Me

verses.original: Ἔβλεπον εἰς ἀλλήλους οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπορούμενοι περὶ τίνος λέγει
verses.transliteration: Eblepon eis allēlous hoi mathētai aporoumenoi peri tinos legei
verses.literal: The disciples looked at one another perplexed as to which of them He meant

verses.original: ἦν ἀνακείμενος εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὃν ἠγάπα ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: ēn anakeimenos heis ek tōn mathētōn autou en tō kolpō tou Iēsou hon ēgapa ho Iēsous
verses.literal: One of His disciples the one whom Jesus loved was reclining at - His side

verses.original: νεύει οὖν τούτῳ Σίμων Πέτρος πυθέσθαι τίς ἂν εἴη περὶ οὗ λέγει
verses.transliteration: neuei oun toutō Simōn Petros pythesthai tis an eiē peri hou legei
verses.literal: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one - He was talking about

verses.original: ἀναπεσὼν οὖν ἐκεῖνος οὕτως ἐπὶ τὸ στῆθος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε τίς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: anapesōn oun ekeinos houtōs epi to stēthos tou Iēsou legei autō Kyrie tis estin
verses.literal: Leaning back against . . . . . . . . . . . . Jesus he asked Lord who is it

verses.original: Ἀποκρίνεται οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ᾧ ἐγὼ βάψω τὸ ψωμίον καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ βάψας οὖν τὸ ψωμίον λαμβάνει καὶ δίδωσιν Ἰούδᾳ Σίμωνος Ἰσκαριώτου
verses.transliteration: Apokrinetai oun ho Iēsous Ekeinos estin hō egō bapsō to psōmion kai dōsō autō bapsas oun to psōmion lambanei kai didōsin Iouda Simōnos Iskariōtou
verses.literal: Jesus answered It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot

verses.original: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ψωμίον τότε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ἐκεῖνον ὁ Σατανᾶς Λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὃ ποιεῖς ποίησον τάχιον
verses.transliteration: kai meta to psōmion tote eisēlthen eis ekeinon ho Satanas Legei oun autō ho Iēsous Ho poieis poiēson tachion
verses.literal: And when Judas had taken . . . the morsel - Satan entered into him Then Jesus said to Judas What you are about to do do quickly

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ οὐδεὶς ἔγνω τῶν ἀνακειμένων πρὸς τί εἶπεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: touto de oudeis egnō tōn anakeimenōn pros ti eipen autō
verses.literal: But no one at the table knew why . . . Jesus had said this to him

verses.original: τινὲς γὰρ ἐδόκουν ἐπεὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον εἶχεν Ἰούδας ὅτι λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀγόρασον ὧν χρείαν ἔχομεν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν ἢ τοῖς πτωχοῖς ἵνα τι δῷ
verses.transliteration: tines gar edokoun epei to glōssokomon eichen Ioudas hoti legei autō ho Iēsous Agorason hōn chreian echomen eis tēn heortēn ē tois ptōchois hina ti dō
verses.literal: Since Judas kept the money bag some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast or to give something to the poor

verses.original: λαβὼν οὖν τὸ ψωμίον ἐκεῖνος ἐξῆλθεν εὐθύς ἦν δὲ νύξ
verses.transliteration: labōn oun to psōmion ekeinos exēlthen euthys ēn de nyx
verses.literal: As soon as he had received . . . the morsel Judas went out into the night

verses.original: Ὅτε οὖν ἐξῆλθεν λέγει Ἰησοῦς Νῦν ἐδοξάσθη ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Hote oun exēlthen legei Iēsous Nyn edoxasthē ho Huios tou anthrōpou kai ho Theos edoxasthē en autō
verses.literal: When Judas had gone out Jesus said Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in Him

verses.original: εἰ ὁ Θεὸς ἐδοξάσθη ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς δοξάσει αὐτὸν ἐν αὑτῷ καὶ εὐθὺς δοξάσει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ei ho Theos edoxasthē en autō kai ho Theos doxasei auton en hautō kai euthys doxasei auton
verses.literal: If God is glorified in Him God will also glorify the Son in Himself and will glorify Him at once

verses.original: Τεκνία ἔτι μικρὸν μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι ζητήσετέ με καὶ καθὼς εἶπον τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν καὶ ὑμῖν λέγω ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: Teknia eti mikron meth’ hymōn eimi zētēsete me kai kathōs eipon tois Ioudaiois hoti Hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein kai hymin legō arti
verses.literal: Little children I am with you only a little while longer You will look for Me and as I said to the Jews so now I say to you Where I am going you cannot come

verses.original: Ἐντολὴν καινὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Entolēn kainēn didōmi hymin hina agapate allēlous kathōs ēgapēsa hymas hina kai hymeis agapate allēlous
verses.literal: A new commandment I give you Love one another As I have loved you so you also must love one another

verses.original: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσονται πάντες ὅτι ἐμοὶ μαθηταί ἐστε ἐὰν ἀγάπην ἔχητε ἐν ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: en toutō gnōsontai pantes hoti emoi mathētai este ean agapēn echēte en allēlois
verses.literal: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples if you love one another

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Σίμων Πέτρος Κύριε ποῦ ὑπάγεις Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς Ὅπου ὑπάγω οὐ δύνασαί μοι νῦν ἀκολουθῆσαι ἀκολουθήσεις δὲ ὕστερον
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Simōn Petros Kyrie pou hypageis Apekrithē autō Iēsous Hopou hypagō ou dynasai moi nyn akolouthēsai akolouthēseis de hysteron
verses.literal: Lord where are You going Simon Peter asked Jesus answered Where I am going you cannot follow Me now but you will follow later

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος Κύριε διὰ τί οὐ δύναμαί σοι ἀκολουθῆσαι ἄρτι τὴν ψυχήν μου ὑπὲρ σοῦ θήσω
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Petros Kyrie dia ti ou dynamai soi akolouthēsai arti tēn psychēn mou hyper sou thēsō
verses.literal: Lord said Peter why . . . can’t I follow You now I will lay down my life for You

verses.original: Ἀποκρίνεται Ἰησοῦς Τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ θήσεις ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι οὐ μὴ ἀλέκτωρ φωνήσῃ ἕως οὗ ἀρνήσῃ με τρίς
verses.transliteration: Apokrinetai Iēsous Tēn psychēn sou hyper emou thēseis amēn amēn legō soi ou mē alektōr phōnēsē heōs hou arnēsē me tris
verses.literal: Will you lay down your life for Me Jesus replied Truly truly I tell you before . . . . . . the rooster crows you will deny Me three times
